rows.headline: Chiron in Aries · 1st House
rows.body_you: Chiron in Aries moves through your 1st house of identity and self-expression, so a comment about your role, appearance, confidence, or independence may hit an older sore spot much harder than the speaker intended. The first move may matter more than consensus, especially if waiting starts to feel like somebody else deciding for you.

A money decision can happen quickly once you know what you want, which makes it worth checking the number before speed becomes the reason.

The first reply may feel obvious. Ten minutes later, you may realize there was another way to say the same point.

rows.headline: Jupiter in Leo · 1st House
rows.body_you:
Jupiter moves through Leo in your 1st house, making your presence harder to minimize and giving you more room to decide how you want to be seen. You may change the way you dress, put your name on work you used to keep behind the scenes, take the lead more quickly, or notice that other people are responding to you with more attention than you are used to receiving. Leo makes recognition feel personal here, so a compliment, invitation, photograph, introduction, or public response can have an outsized effect on how confident you feel that day.

The opportunity is to let greater visibility change what you are willing to attempt without making attention the evidence that you are becoming more valuable. Jupiter can make you feel capable of carrying more than your calendar, body, or actual experience can support, especially when people are enthusiastic about you and it feels good to keep saying yes. Take up more space, try the thing, and let yourself be easier to notice, but keep enough of your judgment intact to know which opportunities still make sense after the confidence becomes part of ordinary life.

rows.headline: Jupiter in Leo · 2nd House
rows.body_you:
Jupiter moves through Leo in your 2nd house, expanding attention around income, possessions, spending, savings, and the practical question of what your time and work are worth. You may earn more, raise a rate, negotiate better pay, attract a larger client, sell something successfully, or finally spend money on a tool or resource that makes your life easier. Leo makes value easier to connect with pride, which can be useful when you have been undercharging or accepting less than you can reasonably ask for.

The complication is that more money coming in can make a more expensive life feel justified almost immediately. A raise can disappear into a higher monthly payment, a good sales month can become a reason to spend like every month will look the same, and buying something impressive can start doing emotional work that the purchase cannot actually sustain. Let this year increase what you can earn and what you can rely on. Keep enough of the gain that your options are genuinely larger after the celebration, not only while the money is moving through your account.
rows.approved_via: Owner explicitly approved all five staged Jupiter-in-Leo passages (houses 1, 2, 3, 4, and 6) with the exact statement “all 5 jupiter in leo are approved” on 2026-09-05.

rows.headline: Jupiter in Leo · 3rd House
rows.body_you:
Jupiter moves through Leo in your 3rd house, increasing the amount of communication, learning, movement, and everyday information competing for your attention. You may write more, speak more publicly, take a class, teach something you know, hear from more people, travel around your local area more often, or find that a conversation leads directly to an opportunity you would not have reached on your own. Leo gives confidence to your voice, which can make it easier to stop qualifying every opinion before you have even finished the sentence.

The risk is assuming that because you have more to say, every thought needs an audience or every invitation deserves an answer. A fuller inbox, more meetings, another short trip, a new course, and three conversations you promised to continue can turn ordinary days into constant interruption. Jupiter can make one idea feel large enough to reorganize the week around it before you know what it will require. Use the extra confidence to say the thing clearly, ask the better question, and follow the information that actually changes a decision. More communication is useful when it leaves you better informed, not simply busier.
rows.approved_via: Owner explicitly approved all five staged Jupiter-in-Leo passages (houses 1, 2, 3, 4, and 6) with the exact statement “all 5 jupiter in leo are approved” on 2026-09-05.

rows.headline: Jupiter in Leo · 4th House
rows.body_you:
Jupiter moves through Leo in your 4th house, expanding home, family, property, and the private life that has to support everything you do in public. You may move, renovate, buy or sell property, make more space for family, host people more often, or decide that your living situation needs to change because the old arrangement no longer fits the life you are building. Leo can make you proud of what you create at home and more willing to invest in a place that feels like yours rather than treating your private life as whatever is left after work and other people are handled.

More space can also come with more cost, more upkeep, and more responsibility than the original idea made obvious. A renovation can keep expanding, a family role can quietly become your job, or generosity can turn into an open-ended expectation that your home, money, or time will absorb whatever other people need. Build a private life that gives something back to you. The bigger home, closer family, or more beautiful space is useful when it makes daily life easier to live, not when maintaining it becomes the next thing everyone assumes you will manage.
rows.approved_via: Owner explicitly approved all five staged Jupiter-in-Leo passages (houses 1, 2, 3, 4, and 6) with the exact statement “all 5 jupiter in leo are approved” on 2026-09-05.

rows.headline: Jupiter in Leo · 5th House
rows.body_you:
Jupiter moves through Leo in your 5th house, bringing more attention to creativity, romance, pleasure, children, and the parts of your life that exist because you enjoy them rather than because somebody assigned them to you. A project that has been sitting half-finished may suddenly feel worth taking seriously, dating can become more active, or you may realize that you have spent so much time being useful that you have become strangely uncomfortable doing something simply because it makes you happy. Leo makes self-expression easier to see here, so work that used to stay private may finally be shared, celebrated, published, performed, or given enough time to become something other people can respond to.

The opportunity is not to turn every hobby into a business or every good date into a five-year plan, but to give more time to the parts of your life that remind you that pleasure can produce something valuable without needing to justify itself first. Jupiter can make the 5th house extravagant, which means you may spend more, promise more, or take bigger emotional risks because the excitement feels convincing in the moment. Let yourself make the thing, take the trip, fall in love, celebrate, or show up more boldly than usual, but pay attention to the difference between a life that has more joy in it and a life that needs constant stimulation to feel interesting. The best thing you build this year may be the part of your schedule that finally belongs to you.
rows.approved_via: Owner supplied this exact passage in the current Codex task on 2026-08-22 and directed restoration without truncation.

rows.headline: Jupiter in Leo · 6th House
rows.body_you:
Jupiter moves through Leo in your 6th house, expanding daily work, routines, appointments, responsibilities, and the systems that determine how much you can actually get done in a week. You may take on more clients, receive more assignments, improve a workflow, hire help, change a health routine, or discover that being good at your job has made other people increasingly comfortable bringing you the difficult task. Leo adds pride to competence here, so being the person who can handle it can feel rewarding right up until your calendar becomes evidence that everyone else has learned to rely on your capacity.

A bigger workload is not automatically a better job. Jupiter can increase opportunity and excess at the same time, which means the new responsibility may be useful while the fifth extra responsibility simply follows you home. Pay attention to what actually improves the day: clearer systems, better tools, enough time between commitments, support from coworkers, and routines you can repeat without needing to recover from them. Let your skills become more valuable this year without turning usefulness into an unlimited resource other people get to schedule.

rows.headline: Jupiter in Leo · 7th House
rows.body_you:
Jupiter moves through Leo in your 7th house, expanding relationships, partnerships, contracts, clients, and the part of your life where another person’s choices have a direct effect on yours. You may meet more people, enter a significant relationship, attract larger clients, formalize a partnership, or discover that an existing connection has reached the point where the two of you need clearer terms because there is more at stake than there used to be. Leo brings warmth and generosity to one-on-one relationships, which can make this a deeply supportive year, but it can also make admiration feel so good that practical incompatibilities are easy to postpone.

Someone being enthusiastic about you is not the same as being able to build a life, business, or agreement with you. Pay attention to what happens after the chemistry, praise, opportunity, or big promise has had time to become ordinary, because that is when schedules, money, communication, responsibility, and follow-through start telling you what the relationship can actually support. Let people love you loudly this year, but make sure they can also show up when nobody is watching.

rows.headline: Jupiter in Leo · 8th House
rows.body_you:
Jupiter moves through Leo in your 8th house, bringing attention to shared money, debt, taxes, inheritance, investments, intimacy, and the agreements that determine who carries what when resources and responsibilities are combined. You may receive financial support, restructure debt, merge finances, deal with an estate, secure funding, or enter a relationship where the practical questions around trust become impossible to treat as separate from the emotional ones. Leo can make generosity larger here, but it can also make pride interfere with conversations about who owes what, who has access, and who gets to make decisions once money or responsibility is shared.

This is a good year to improve the terms, not to pretend terms are unnecessary because everybody involved has good intentions. Put the numbers in writing, understand what you are signing, ask who controls the account, and do not confuse somebody’s willingness to spend generously with their willingness to share power. Jupiter can increase what is available to you through other people, but the arrangement works best when nobody has to stay confused in order to keep the peace.
rows.approved_via: Owner-authored verbatim in Content Studio on 2026-08-22; migrated from the governed inventory into a non-generated source of truth.

rows.headline: Jupiter in Leo · 9th House
rows.body_you:
Jupiter, moving through Leo in your 9th house, expands education, travel, publishing, teaching, belief, and the larger questions that change what you think your life could become. You may return to school, travel farther, publish your work, begin teaching, enter a legal or academic process, or become much more serious about an idea that used to live mostly in conversation. Leo gives conviction to this part of the chart, which can help you speak with more confidence about what you know, especially after a period of collecting information without deciding what you actually believe.

The risk is becoming so attached to the idea that you are right that curiosity starts disappearing from the process. Jupiter likes big explanations and Leo likes confidence, but the strongest argument still has to survive new information, particularly when somebody with less status, fewer credentials, or a different background notices something you missed. Let the world get bigger this year without requiring every new experience to confirm what you already thought.
rows.approved_via: Owner-authored verbatim in Content Studio on 2026-08-22; migrated from the governed inventory into a non-generated source of truth.

rows.headline: Jupiter in Leo · 10th House
rows.body_you:
Jupiter moves through Leo in your 10th house, bringing growth to career, reputation, leadership, recognition, and the responsibilities attached to being known for what you do. You may receive a promotion, publish something important, take on a more visible role, attract a larger client base, or finally reach the point where people are asking you to make decisions instead of waiting for somebody else to approve yours. Leo adds pride and visibility to this part of your chart, so the desire to be taken seriously can become much stronger, particularly if you have spent years doing work that other people benefited from without giving you the title, money, or credit that should have come with it.

The danger is accepting every visible opportunity because it looks like progress from the outside. More responsibility is only useful when the authority, compensation, support, and time required to do the job have grown with it, and a title can become expensive very quickly when you are expected to carry problems you were never given the power to solve. Let the year make your work easier to recognize, but make sure recognition changes the terms too.
rows.approved_via: Owner-authored verbatim in Content Studio on 2026-08-22; migrated from the governed inventory into a non-generated source of truth.

rows.headline: Jupiter in Leo · 11th House
rows.body_you:
Jupiter moves through Leo in your 11th house, expanding friendships, communities, professional networks, audiences, and the long-term goals that become more possible when the right people know what you are trying to build. You may meet collaborators, find yourself included in rooms that used to feel difficult to enter, receive more invitations, or realize that one introduction has opened a door you would have struggled to reach on your own. Leo makes visibility inside groups more important, which can bring genuine recognition for what you contribute but can also expose how quickly belonging becomes complicated when everybody wants to be the person being noticed.

Pay attention to the groups where success is shared and the ones where every opportunity quietly turns into a contest for access, attention, or proximity to whoever has the most influence. Jupiter can give you a larger circle this year, but a larger circle is not automatically a better one, especially if keeping your place requires constant attendance, emotional work, or enthusiasm you no longer feel. Invest in the connections that still make sense when there is nothing useful to gain from being seen together.
rows.approved_via: Owner-authored verbatim in Content Studio on 2026-08-22; migrated from the governed inventory into a non-generated source of truth.

rows.headline: Jupiter in Leo · 12th House
rows.body_you:
Jupiter moves through Leo in your 12th house, expanding the part of your life that operates privately, including rest, endings, solitude, grief, recovery, and the thoughts that become easier to hear when there is finally less noise around them. A year like this can feel quieter from the outside even when a great deal is changing internally, particularly if you are closing out a long chapter, working on something before it is ready to be public, or realizing how much of your exhaustion has come from treating every open hour as time that should be used productively.

Leo brings pride into a house that usually asks for privacy, which can expose how difficult it is to rest when nobody can see what you accomplished with the day, or how quickly you start explaining yourself when you need time away from people who are accustomed to your availability. You do not need to disappear, but you may need to become much more selective about what deserves access to you while this cycle is clearing space. Some of the most important work you do this year may have nothing impressive to show for it until much later.

The year expands your reach by pairing you well: partnerships form easier, the right people take a liking to you, and grace becomes a genuine asset rather than a social reflex. Confidence arrives relationally. The year's task is keeping your own outline visible inside all the successful pairing; expansion that erases you is not growth.

Ask for the real number; grace and a low rate are not the same virtue.

Retire one accommodation kindly, starting with your own.

rows.headline: Lilith in Aquarius · 1st House
rows.body_you:
Black Moon Lilith spends about nine months in your 1st house, making it almost impossible to keep hiding the parts of yourself you toned down to please others. You might stop softening your opinions, refuse to dress for anyone else's approval, or stop laughing off things that bother you. That sudden edge is useful; it shows exactly where you have been compromising your personality.

The trap is picking fights just to prove a point. Acting out is not the same thing as being free. Restore the parts of yourself you hid because they belong to you, not just to shock an audience.
rows.approved_via: Verbatim reuse of an existing approved transit passage; no prose changes.

rows.headline: Lilith in Aquarius · 2nd House
rows.body_you:
Black Moon Lilith in your 2nd house makes your true desires around money, comfort, possessions, and lifestyle impossible to pass off as mere "practicality." You might finally admit the income you want, the quality you prefer, or the comforts you denied yourself because wanting them felt greedy or shallow. Resentment builds when you suppress every desire until it explodes in impulse buying.

This is not an excuse to blow your savings or make pointlessly flashy purchases. It is about dropping the guilt around wanting nice things so you can manage your money intentionally. Wanting comfort does not make you a bad person.
rows.approved_via: Verbatim reuse of an existing approved transit passage; no prose changes.

rows.headline: Lilith in Aquarius · 3rd House
rows.body_you:
With Black Moon Lilith in your 3rd house, swallowed words and unaddressed conversations become too heavy to carry. You will notice how often you dilute a disagreement into vague politeness, leave important texts in drafts, or rewrite your point so it does not upset anyone. Those unsaid words do not vanish; they show up as low-key resentment toward people who do not even know the full story.

Do not unleash months of pent-up annoyance all at once and label it "being honest." Direct communication still works best with good timing and clear delivery. Speak the clear truth to the person who actually needs to hear it.
rows.approved_via: Verbatim reuse of an existing approved transit passage; no prose changes.

rows.headline: Lilith in Aquarius · 4th House
rows.body_you:
Black Moon Lilith in your 4th house shines a light on the family secrets, taboo topics, or toxic relatives everyone pretends not to notice. You might refuse to keep the peace by sweeping things under the rug, protecting the most difficult family member, or playing the scapegoat. Silence keeps family events smooth, but it destroys real honesty.

You do not need to start a massive fight at Thanksgiving. It can be as simple as setting a firm personal boundary, confiding in one safe person, or refusing to play along with a fake narrative anymore. A household built on truth will look very different from the one you grew up in.
rows.approved_via: Verbatim reuse of an existing approved transit passage; no prose changes.

rows.headline: Lilith in Aquarius · 5th House
rows.body_you:
Black Moon Lilith in your 5th house brings creative, romantic, and personal desires out of hiding. You might return to an unconventional art form, admit an inconvenient crush, or feel angry about how much fun you sacrificed after someone made you feel stupid for enjoying it. Desire gets loud when it has been treated like something to be ashamed of.

Reclaim your right to enjoy what you like without turning it into a dramatic statement. You do not need to shock anyone or over-explain your taste. The shift is letting yourself enjoy what you love without needing to justify it to anyone.
rows.approved_via: Verbatim reuse of an existing approved transit passage; no prose changes.

rows.headline: Lilith in Aquarius · 6th House
rows.body_you:
Black Moon Lilith in your 6th house makes resentment about work, routines, and physical limits impossible to write off as just a bad mood. You become acutely aware of unpaid work, extra duties dumped on you without asking, or a work schedule that completely ignores your health. Burnout is what happens long after "no" was the answer.

The solution is not always quitting on the spot. It looks like turning down tasks that are not your responsibility, holding firm on deadlines, taking real breaks, and admitting that your reliability has been taken for granted. A clean, firm "no" works better than an angry exit.
rows.approved_via: Verbatim reuse of an existing approved transit passage; no prose changes.

rows.headline: Lilith in Aquarius · 7th House
rows.body_you:
Black Moon Lilith in your 7th house brings hidden imbalances in close relationships right out into the open. You will be far less willing to swallow your anger, let the other person make all the choices, or play the easygoing partner just to avoid a fight. Resentment always highlights where an unfair dynamic was accepted instead of negotiated.

This transit forces real renegotiation, but remember that healthy relationships still involve some friction. A connection gets stronger when both people can voice what they need and work through the differences. Do not throw away a good relationship over minor flaws before giving the other person a chance to step up.
rows.approved_via: Verbatim reuse of an existing approved transit passage; no prose changes.

rows.headline: Lilith in Aquarius · 8th House
rows.body_you:
Black Moon Lilith in your 8th house makes taboos around money, sex, grief, power, and secrets impossible to ignore. These topics need clear, upfront conversation because avoiding them is making decisions for you. You might also realize where you surrendered your personal power during an old crisis and never took it back.

This is not about oversharing your private life with just anyone. Some details belong only with people who have earned your trust. Bring hidden issues out into honest conversations with trusted people without using vulnerability as a weapon or secrecy as a shield.
rows.approved_via: Verbatim reuse of an existing approved transit passage; no prose changes.

rows.headline: Lilith in Aquarius · 9th House
rows.body_you:
Black Moon Lilith in your 9th house makes inherited beliefs, religious dogmas, and authority figures fair game for questioning. You might challenge a teacher, reject a tradition, or admit that a philosophy you were taught does not match your real life. That break feels uncomfortable when fitting in required you to repeat the approved script.

Rebellion for its own sake is not true freedom. Simply opposing everything still lets someone else's rules control your attention. Build a core set of beliefs that survives your own tough questions, rather than picking a stance just to irritate the people who taught you.
rows.approved_via: Verbatim reuse of an existing approved transit passage; no prose changes.

rows.headline: Lilith in Aquarius · 10th House
rows.body_you:
Black Moon Lilith in your 10th house exposes how much of your professional image was built around being palatable.
